text: Cooking transforms simple ingredients into delicious meals, a skill mastered by every home cook. To start, onions are crucial as they add depth and a sweet flavor to dishes. Onions are versatile and can be easily incorporated into various recipes, from soups and stews to stir-fries and salads. Garlic, another essential ingredient, complements the onion's flavor, adding a pungent and savory taste. Together, these two ingredients make a powerful duo in many cuisines, adding a rich and aromatic flavor to meals. Mastering the art of cooking begins with understanding the roles of these two fundamental ingredients.
